title: Portfolio hub project report
description: Shared report contract. Spec: .agents/instructions/portfolio-hub-reporting.md. Framework-owned — a project must NOT edit this file; doing so silently removes it from the portfolio. Accepts schema_version 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2.

schema_version.description: 1.1 added the optional 'edge' field (absent = repo). 1.2 added the 'deploy' edge. All remain valid.

project.description: Stable lowercase slug matching the hub registry. Renaming breaks report history.

edge.description: Which line produced this report. repo = autopilot/dev state, derived from committed git state. deploy = build and release status, collected by the HUB from the hosting platform API (no project-side work). runtime = live product signals, served by the app itself. A project may be covered by several lines; the hub merges them per period. No line may answer for another.

source_sha.description: Git commit this report describes. THE correlation key across lines: it is what lets the hub say 'task merged as abc123, but its deployment failed'. Include it wherever the line can know it; without it the hub can only correlate on timestamps, which is guesswork.

status.description: Health of report GENERATION, not of the product. Product problems belong in the risks section.

sections.description: Exactly six, in this order. An empty section keeps its key with body 'none' — never omit.

body.description: Markdown. Use the literal string 'none' when there is nothing to report.

provenance.description: Where this section's content came from. measured = read from an API or file. derived = computed from measured data. asserted = prose a project or agent wrote about itself. The hub uses this to avoid relaying a guess to the founder as a fact.
